translation.headerInfo: Here, you'll see a summary of your apiary with the total hive count and apiary name. To update any information, simply tap on Edit and keep your details updated.
translation.inspectionHiveInfo: Easily check your hives health by answering a few quick questions. You can also upload a picture of your hive to identify any symptoms and get treatment suggestions for common issues.
translation.markYourActivityInfo: Keep track of everything you've done by marking your activities as you go. This makes it easy to remember past work and stay organized over time.
translation.profitAndLossInfo: Track your sales and calculate your profit or loss here. Enter each sale to get an up-to-date picture of how your apiary is doing financially.
translation.harvestHiveInfo: Log your harvest details, whether it's honey, pollen, or any other product. This way, you will have a clear record of what you've produced and can better manage your yields.
